statement: At SDL commit 6defbc0129b5ba90bab3f6c67bbc1e9329e24ff1, controller_list.h lines 670-671 classifies 28de:1302 and 28de:1303 as Triton. SDL_hidapi_steam_triton.c lines 429-451 accepts direct Triton by identity without an interface-number filter; its receiver branch requires interfaces 2 through 5. SDL_hidapijoystick.c lines 390-401 exempts Valve devices from generic usage-page and usage filters. Linux hidapi hid.c lines 783-803 preserves interface_number -1 and handles missing USB parents for UHID USB devices. The older SDL_hidapi_steam.c driver has different interface rules and is not the direct 2026 model driver.

applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only; no physical observation or device-side protocol promotion
